_comment: Dubai Metro and taxi journeys (components/transit). Station names as of Sept 2026 (Onpassive renamed Garmin). Announcement wording follows the usual pattern; it is not RTA's script. Real recordings, if licensed, can be dropped into public/audio/metro/ as <station-id>-next.mp3 and <station-id>-this.mp3 and play instead of the synthesised voice.

greetings: Salam alaikum! Where are we going today?
Marhaba! Please, put your seatbelt on.
smallTalk: Traffic is good today, inshallah we will be there soon.
You like Dubai? Every year something new is built.
Sheikh Zayed Road is busy in the evening, but now is fine.
Have you been to the Dubai Frame? Very nice view.
First time in Dubai? You must try karak chai.
